about: Sitting 4b (the Cafeteria's and the girls' corridor's evening and night) written early by hand on 10 Oct 2026 at the owner's word ('Can we go on with the next batch of images?'), from the two day pictures chosen in 4a, which are NOT installed: the Cafeteria's version A and the corridor composed afresh (ui2_girls_dorm5x_b). Each was fitted to 1920x1080 and laid into a scratch root as the installed file would be, with a scratch manifest; the prompts are the tool's own relight prompt (make_redo_workflow.prompt_for) with the hour sentences below.

The Cafeteria's night follows the owner's ruling O38 (lights off, moonlight), offered here as the default and told to the owner. The corridor has no window but the one at its far end, so its hour sentences are its own, and its night is painted two ways for the owner to choose between: one ceiling light on low, and every light off. Every corridor sentence ends 'Add no new window and no new light', because a window in a side wall is what the owner had removed (O37).

Judge the results without installing: tools/py_art.sh tools/install_redo.py --relight <place> <evening|night> <a> <b> --dry --against <the chosen day render>, then by eye against the day picture for anything added. The corridor's keep list (tools/bgs/keep/girls_dorm.json) still describes the picture of before the overhaul, so the check's 'vanished' list is not to be trusted there until the corridor is laid out afresh.

sentences.cafeteria_night: Change the time of day to night, with every light in the room switched off: the hanging ceiling lamps are dark. Outside the windows it is night, under a deep blue sky with stars. The room is lit only by cool blue moonlight coming in through the windows, which lies in pale patches on the floor and the tables. The room is dim, but everything in it can still be seen clearly.
sentences.girls_dorm_evening: Change the time of day to early evening: the sky in the window at the far end of the corridor is orange and pink, and low warm orange sunlight comes in through that window and lies along the floor with long soft shadows. The ceiling lights are switched on and give a soft warm light. Add no new window and no new light.
sentences.girls_dorm_night: Change the time of day to night: the sky in the window at the far end of the corridor is deep blue with stars. Only the nearest ceiling light is switched on, turned low, and gives a dim warm glow; the other ceiling lights are dark, and the far end of the corridor is in soft blue shadow, with pale moonlight on the floor under the window. The corridor is dim, but every door can still be seen clearly. Add no new window and no new light.
sentences.girls_dorm_night_off: Change the time of day to night, with every light in the corridor switched off: the ceiling lights are dark. The sky in the window at the far end is deep blue with stars. The corridor is lit only by cool blue moonlight coming in through that window, which lies in a pale patch on the floor. The corridor is dim, but every door can still be seen clearly. Add no new window and no new light.
sentences.cafeteria_evening: Change the time of day to early evening: low warm orange sunlight slants in through the windows, long soft shadows cross the floor, and the sky outside is orange and pink.

rows.label: Girls' Dormitory, night, one light on low

renders_kept_in: ~/Desktop/JJK Game images/ui2/early/renders/ (the ten files as ComfyUI saved them on 10 Oct 2026)

install_redo_dry.the_refusals: all three name the same two things: 'the floor where people stand (a row of 3, at x 760)' and '(a row of 4, at x 800)' no longer line up. Read by eye they are FALSE ALARMS: the floor has not moved (the whole picture is 0, 0 px off and no other point is off by more than 2 px); the window frames' shadow now lies across those floor points as a grid of sunlight or moonlight, which evening B happens not to throw there.
install_redo_dry.girls_dorm: all six PASS on the points (0 to 1 px). Its vanished list reads the old corridor's keep list and means nothing here.

by_eye.cafeteria_evening: both faithful; nothing added or gone. A lights the three hanging lamps and throws the window grid across the floor: it reads as the dinner hour. B leaves the lamps unlit and puts one broad beam on the back wall.
by_eye.cafeteria_night: both faithful; lamps dark, moonlight on the floor and the tables. A is the clearer (mean 78; 6.5% of it darker than 25); B is darker (68; 11.7%) and its tables sink.
by_eye.girls_dorm_evening: both keep six doors, no side window, the shoe rack, the plant and the trees in the end window. A has far more evening in it, but paints sunset light on BOTH side walls at once, which one low sun through the end window cannot do. B is quiet and correct: a patch on the floor at the far end and a glow on one wall; it is close to the day picture in brightness (141 against 160).
by_eye.girls_dorm_night_one_light_low: A is the better of the two (a warm pool under the nearest lamp, blue depth beyond; mean 92); B is too bright to read as night (104). In both the trees outside the end window are gone, replaced by plain starry sky.
by_eye.girls_dorm_night_lights_off: A is faithful and convincing (mean 85): every lamp dark, moonlight on the floor under the window, every door plain to see, and the trees still outside the window. B is too bright to read as night (110) and loses the trees.

read_10_oct.my_picks: Cafeteria: evening A, night A. Corridor: night with the lights off, version A (no fault in it, and it follows O38); its evening is close: A for the mood, B for light that is strictly believable. Put to the owner; nothing was chosen when this was written.
read_10_oct.for_the_installer: A seventh blind spot, the same family as the first three of art_3a_early.json: in a relight, a standing-row point on open floor is refused when the new light throws an edge across it (a window grid of sunlight or moonlight). The floor cannot move on its own while every other point agrees to 2 px; the check should say LOOK there, not REFUSED. Tests: ui2_cafeteria_evening_a and both cafeteria nights must not be refused; evening B must still pass.
read_10_oct.a_relight_can_lose_what_is_outside_a_win: three of the four corridor nights drop the trees outside the end window. The hour sentence says what the sky is but not that what stands outside stays: say so in a night sentence ('the dark shapes of the trees outside are still there against the sky').

chosen.said: the owner, in chat, 10 Oct 2026: "Lets go with your picks, they look good to me. Only thing is that 1/3 lights are on in Night lights on renders. Can be fixed later, if at all." (my picks were: the Cafeteria's evening A and night A; the corridor's night with the lights off, version A; the corridor's evening A, narrowly)
chosen.not_chosen: the corridor's night with one ceiling light on low (ui2_girls_dorm_night_a/b): the owner remarked that one lamp of three is lit there and that it can be fixed later, if at all; it is not used, so nothing is fixed
